name: Hospital-Management
description: This project is an Advanced Hospital Management System (HMS) web application. It provides a user-friendly interface for managing hospital operations, including appointment booking, patient management, and doctor information.

paragraphs: HealthHub is a comprehensive React-based hospital management system designed to streamline healthcare operations and improve patient care. This system provides an intuitive interface for managing appointments, patient records, doctor information, and administrative tasks.
features: User-friendly Interface: Clean and responsive design for easy navigation across devices.
Appointment Management: Schedule and manage patient appointments efficiently.
Patient Records: Maintain detailed patient information and medical history.
Doctor Directory: Access a list of doctors with their specialties and patient counts.
Administrative Tools: Secure admin panel for overseeing system operations and generating reports.

whatItDoes.text: HealthHub is a comprehensive React-based hospital management system designed to streamline healthcare operations and improve patient care. This system provides an intuitive interface for managing appointments, patient records, doctor information, and administrative tasks.

requirements.text: Admin: Secure login for administrative tasks and report generation.
